results.title: France – Printing services – Impression des supports de Communication de la Ville de Beaucaire
unknowns: Exact lot-by-lot candidate qualification/reference requirements from the RC still require canonical DCE linkage
Compliant printer pricing, production capacity, samples if any and delivery economics are not yet locked
results.why: Very strong print-broker opportunity: open procedure, ten separable printing/finishing/delivery lots and a EUR 1.36m maximum framework value. Public lot ceilings include EUR 320k for small formats, EUR 400k for magazines/booklets, EUR 120k for posters and several EUR 80k specialty lots. The structure permits selective pursuit rather than taking the whole contract. This is commercially attractive for the existing European print-supplier middleman model, but supplier economics and exact RC gates still prevent a clean GREEN today.

results.title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Support für die rbb-Onlinedienste
unknowns: SPM alone has not evidenced two comparable operational-support references
Required Adobe AEM, Linux administration and related personnel certifications/knowledge are not evidenced for SPM
results.why: The buyer needs operational support for a large portfolio of live rbb web properties, including 2nd-level support for Adobe Experience Manager and web applications, incident handling and out-of-hours availability. The tender requires two comparable references plus specified employee knowledge/certifications. This is enterprise web operations rather than lean website delivery and therefore needs an established AEM/Linux support partner.

results.title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – HIL Internetseite
unknowns: SPM alone does not evidence the three highly specific comparable references
Required TYPO3-certified project-team capability and insurance are not evidenced for SPM
results.why: Website relaunch and 48-month maintenance are a strong functional fit and the procedure is SME-suitable, but qualification is agency-grade: three comparable projects with specific security, SLA/support and ticketing characteristics, project-team continuity, current person-bound TYPO3 certifications and liability insurance. This is a viable web-agency partner route, not a lean-direct bid.

results.title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – SV-KWA-260819-002, Weiterentwicklung Unternehmenswebsite
unknowns: SPM alone does not evidence the exact three mandatory enterprise-grade reference cases
Required staffing depth and comparable critical-infrastructure/enterprise delivery history are not evidenced for SPM
results.why: Excellent native scope: frontend development and project management, with optional UX strategy and visual design, on the existing SWM website stack. However the selection criteria demand exactly three highly specific comparable references covering continuous enterprise website development, a complex frontend/digital process and a productive Angular application, alongside structured build/test/security/accessibility practices and extended productive operation. Strong agency-partner target, not direct GREEN.

results.title: Ireland – 0041 - Qualification System for the Provision of Search and Generative Engine Optimisation (SEO and GEO) Services
unknowns: Qualification-stage financial, reference and team thresholds are not exposed in the recovered compact DCE and remain unverified
SPM has not yet demonstrated the buyer-specific SEO/GEO track record required for panel qualification
results.why: Strategically excellent fit: An Post is creating a long-lived supplier panel for traditional SEO plus emerging AI Search/GEO, covering strategy, optimisation execution, technical deployment, measurement and reporting. The panel may remain open for up to ten years, so there is no near-term bid-window pressure. This is worth qualifying for, but mandatory qualification thresholds must be verified before promotion to GREEN.

results.title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Entwicklung einer integrierten Webanwendung mit Fokus auf erweiterter Realität (AR) für Sport- und Kulturthemen
unknowns: Exact reference, turnover, team and insurance thresholds are not yet resolved from authoritative tender documents
Integration constraints of the existing Hildesheim Smart-City platform and required German-language stakeholder delivery are not yet fully resolved
results.why: One of the strongest reconstructed software opportunities for the lean build model: concept, development, implementation and go-live of a browser-based integrated web application combining AR cultural tours, digitised sports infrastructure and app-based health/sports campaigns, with Smart-City platform integration. It is an open, SME-suitable electronic procedure. The scope is technically achievable, but unresolved mandatory qualification and integration gates mean it cannot yet be promoted to GREEN.
